title: Model Selection Matrix & Benchmark Evaluation
description: Evaluate foundation models across MMLU, HumanEval, and SWE-bench, balancing latency, reasoning depth, cost, and hosting constraints.

data.text: Selecting the right AI model is an architectural trade-off balancing reasoning capabilities, latency, per-token cost, context capacity, and compliance boundaries. Defaulting to the largest available frontier model for every task leads to exorbitant cloud bills and sluggish UI performance; conversely, relying solely on small models results in hallucinations and failed tool calls.

rows: High-volume classification, triage, routing, formatting, simple entity extraction
Complex agentic reasoning, code synthesis, advanced RAG, enterprise customer support
Formal mathematical proofs, multi-file code refactoring, complex legal/financial audits
Air-gapped compliance, local developer workstations, zero-data-retention needs

data.title: Core Evaluation Benchmarks
items: MMLU (Massive Multitask Language Understanding): Measures broad factual knowledge and problem-solving across 57 academic subjects (STEM, humanities, medicine).
HumanEval: Evaluates Python and algorithmic coding ability through automated unit test pass rates.
SWE-bench: Real-world software engineering benchmark evaluating a model's ability to resolve end-to-end GitHub issues in actual repositories.
MATH & GSM8K: Measures multi-step mathematical reasoning and quantitative problem solving.
Needle In A Haystack (NIAH): Tests retrieval accuracy when a specific fact is buried within long context windows.

items.hint: Can data leave company premises? If no, select Llama 3 or Phi-3 via on-prem hardware. If yes, choose Azure OpenAI with region pinning.
Is it simple keyword extraction or multi-step logic? For simple parsing, use GPT-4o-mini. For complex orchestration, use GPT-4o or Sonnet.
Does the user interface require sub-second streaming? Lightweight models deliver 2x-3x higher tokens per second.
At 100,000 queries per day, switching from GPT-4o to GPT-4o-mini saves over $15,000 per month.
Verify model benchmark accuracy on structured JSON schema conformance before selecting smaller open-weights models for agentic loops.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Adopt a multi-model strategy: match model cost and latency to specific task complexity
Use lightweight models (GPT-4o-mini) for high-frequency extraction, classification, and routing
Reserve frontier generalists (GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet) for agentic planning and synthesis
Deploy deep reasoning models (o1, o3-mini) for complex analytical logic where latency is secondary
Benchmark candidate models on your own domain-specific dataset rather than relying solely on public leaderboards
data.takeaway: Pragmatic model selection separates successful enterprise AI from expensive experiments. Choosing the right tier ensures high accuracy, fast user response, and sustainable unit economics.
